entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF78-2026-11942.
Thank you, Sam. I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered on January 12th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It’s a preference issue. I ordered the medium, but it’s the wrong size. The jersey is just too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping to do an exchange for a large.
Understood. Thanks for clarifying. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Alright, Sam, I've confirmed it. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item and you received it just six days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this exchange for you.
That's great news. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and sending it back, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase for the trouble?

I understand the request. While our system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns, I do see that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, what I can do is process this as a return for a full refund now, and I'll place a new order for the large jersey with complimentary expedited shipping. How does that sound?
Oh, expedited shipping on the exchange? That actually works out much better. I appreciate you doing that. Yes, let's proceed.

Excellent. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we receive the original jersey, your full refund will be processed. The new order for the large size is also placed and should be with you in 1-2 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful, Alex. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sam. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
